title: Melt the self into praise
summary: This meets the mind hardened by self-consciousness and comparison. The line imagines praise as fusion, not performance.
lifeApplication: Before sizing yourself up beside someone else, notice the hard edge in the chest. Repeat the line until attention warms enough to join rather than compare.

source.shortMeaning: In praise, the separate self softens and begins to merge with the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind hardens, stay with praise until the edge begins to soften.

evidence.coreClaim: In praise, the separate self softens and begins to merge with the Lord.
evidence.turn: Let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before sizing yourself up beside someone else, notice the hard edge in the chest. Repeat the line until attention warms enough to join rather than compare.
